# Awesome BMVC 2025 Accepted Papers (Non-official personal categories) 📚

> British Machine Vision Conference 2025 - Accepted Papers

This document compiles the accepted papers from BMVC 2025, organized by research topic.

**Note**: According to the official BMVC 2025 website, 276 papers were accepted out of 865 submissions. The website may have displayed an incorrect number (1257) in some places, but the actual count is 276.
